hyperedges.label: Identity sub-module page group (Overview/Projects/Experience/Education/Certifications/Skills/Social sharing IdentityShared)
In-browser JSX transpilation runtime (React + ReactDOM UMD + @babel/standalone transpiling all app/*.jsx at load time)
Transitive dependency version-pin overrides (security-sensitive packages forced to minimum patched versions)
Frontend Local Dev Environment Setup (pnpm + Docker + README)
Auth / OTP Flow Aligned Across Route Docs, Design Prototype, and Backend Context
Two-Token Tool Theming Pattern (accent-primary + accent-subtle across Portfolio/Photo/Productivity)
Button component variant/size/dark-theme preview set implementing the same btn classes
Design system color token previews (accents, gray primitives, status colors) share the same token system
Multi-tool dark-mode accent theming pattern: shared components re-skin per-tool accent (photo, productivity) using the accent family tokens
Spacing-group layout tokens (motion, radius, spacing scale)
Theming & semantic color token mechanism (light/dark tokens driving per-tool theme swap)
Typography scale preview group (display / body / labels)

nodes.label: Collapsed Sidebar Variant 2 - Admin Dashboard (Super Admin Workspace): shows the icon-only collapsed left rail (logo glyph, expand chevron, grid/dashboard icon highlighted with green active indicator dot, server/rack icon, people icon, terminal/logs icon, gear/settings icon, then a divider, user avatar 'HA', bell notification icon, and logout icon at the bottom). The main content area displays the 'Admin Dashboard' heading with date 'Tuesday, June 16, 2026', four KPI cards (Total Users 12,483 all time; Active Today 1,247 last 24h; New This Week 340 registrations; Services Running 6 live) each with a small teal-tinted icon badge, a 'User Growth' line/area chart card (30-day daily active users, +12.4% badge, teal gradient area chart trending upward), and a 'Service Usage' card listing active users per service as horizontal progress bars (Productivity 5,210, Portfolio 4,820, Photo 3,640, Drive 2,980). hyperedges.label: Identity sub-module page group (Overview/Projects/Experience/Education/Certifications/Skills/Social sharing IdentityShared)
In-browser JSX transpilation runtime (React + ReactDOM UMD + @babel/standalone transpiling all app/*.jsx at load time)
Transitive dependency version-pin overrides (security-sensitive packages forced to minimum patched versions)
Frontend Local Dev Environment Setup (pnpm + Docker + README)
Auth / OTP Flow Aligned Across Route Docs, Design Prototype, and Backend Context
Two-Token Tool Theming Pattern (accent-primary + accent-subtle across Portfolio/Photo/Productivity)
Button component variant/size/dark-theme preview set implementing the same btn classes
Design system color token previews (accents, gray primitives, status colors) share the same token system
Multi-tool dark-mode accent theming pattern: shared components re-skin per-tool accent (photo, productivity) using the accent family tokens
Spacing-group layout tokens (motion, radius, spacing scale)
Theming & semantic color token mechanism (light/dark tokens driving per-tool theme swap)
Typography scale preview group (display / body / labels)
